_table: Security deposit interest (states that statutorily require it)
_note: Only states that require interest are listed; absent states impose no statewide interest duty.
_notice: General reference, not legal advice. Statutes change and vary by jurisdiction; verify every figure against the current official state code before relying on it. Last reviewed 2026-05.

CT.rule: Conn. Gen. Stat. § 47a-21(i): interest at rate determined annually by Banking Commissioner; paid annually

DC.rule: D.C. Code § 42-3502.17(c) and 14 DCMR § 311: interest at the greater of US Treasury yield curve rate or 1.5%/year, accrues monthly after 6 months

IA.rule: Iowa Code § 562A.12(2): interest earned during first 5 years is landlord's property; after 5 years it is tenant's

IL.rule: 765 ILCS 715/1 (statewide, buildings of 25+ units, deposit held > 6 months: interest at the largest IL commercial bank's passbook rate) and Chicago RLTO § 5-12-080 (all Chicago units, rate set annually by the City)

MA.rule: M.G.L. ch. 186 § 15B(3): 5% per year or actual rate of interest if landlord deposits in interest-bearing account; pay annually

MD.rule: Md. Code, Real Prop. § 8-203(e): simple interest at 1.5%/year (or 4%/year statutory minimum depending on year deposit posted), held > 6 months

MN.rule: Minn. Stat. § 504B.178(2): 1% simple interest per year

ND.rule: N.D. Cent. Code § 47-16-07.1: deposit held in a federally-insured interest-bearing account; interest paid to the tenant when occupancy exceeds 9 months

NH.rule: N.H. Rev. Stat. § 540-A:6(IV): interest paid annually upon written request at the rate paid by the institution; held > 1 year

NJ.rule: N.J.S.A. 46:8-19(b): interest paid annually at actual rate earned (less 1% administrative fee in some cases)

NM.rule: N.M.S.A. § 47-8-18(D): annual interest equal to passbook rate; deposits over 1 month of rent

NY.rule: NY GOL § 7-103(2-a): interest at the prevailing rate paid by the depository, less 1% administrative fee for landlords with 6+ units

OH.rule: Ohio Rev. Code § 5321.16(A): 5%/year on amounts over $50 (or 1 month's rent, whichever greater) if tenant remains 6+ months

PA.rule: 68 P.S. § 250.511b: after 2 years of tenancy, interest accrues at lender's prevailing rate; landlord may deduct 1% admin fee
